name: seco
description: Local-first professional identity engine for reviewed experience capture and Obsidian-ready career memory.
long_description: seco captures professional experiences through a guided text or voice intake flow, saves reviewed memories locally, and renders them for Obsidian, resumes, LinkedIn, GitHub README, LaTeX, cover letters, and bios. User data stays on the local machine except for BYOK calls to configured model or transcription providers.

tools.name: start_intake_session
tools.description: Begin a guided reviewed experience intake session.

tools.name: continue_intake_session
tools.description: Continue guided text intake with the latest user reply.

tools.name: save_reviewed_intake_session
tools.description: Save a reviewed intake draft after explicit confirmation.

tools.name: get_intake_session_result
tools.description: Fetch active draft progress or the saved intake result.

tools.name: render_for_surface
tools.description: Render saved experiences for Obsidian, resumes, LinkedIn, GitHub README, LaTeX, cover letters, and bios.

tools.name: export_obsidian_note
tools.description: Export saved experiences as Obsidian vault-ready Markdown.

tools.name: tailor_to_jd
tools.description: Select and render the strongest saved experiences for a job description.

anthropic_api_key.title: Anthropic API key
anthropic_api_key.description: Required for guided extraction and rendering. Stored by Claude Desktop as sensitive configuration.

openai_api_key.title: OpenAI API key
openai_api_key.description: Optional. Enables Whisper fallback for voice transcription.
